comparison.objective: Hook a wire to fish tape and pull it through bent conduit; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable hooking and long-path pulling versus rigid coaxial mandrel placement, impact control, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Wire end emerges ≥5 cm while the hook remains joined versus four tangs fracture and enter containment without damage.
comparison.reason: Shared tool use and alignment are generic; the tested mechanisms differ.
